description: Find a domain for a storefront: send query (a name, tried with .com, .ai, .io, .co, .app, .dev, .shop and .store) or domains (up to 50 exact ones) and get whether each is available and its first-year price in USD. Read-only: nothing is registered or paid. Only where the workspace has storefronts and domain search switched on (else an error with code not_released). Needs a Last Price credential with workspace settings read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

domains.description: Exact domains to ask about instead of query.

query.description: A name to try with common endings, such as acme pricing.

name: search_storefront_domains
